verdict.rationale: Datacenter-scale interconnect is a fair question for any GPU, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no NVLink, multi-GPU interconnect, or rack-scale deployment for the RTX 5070 Ti. Its own material covers gaming, creator and local AI PC use. The CUDA Toolkit's statement about deploying to data centers describes the software platform, not this card, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can train and serve at datacenter scale on this part — documented high-bandwidth interconnect (NVLink, Infinity Fabric), multi-GPU systems, and rack-scale deployment
